snippet.title: Why FIFA Spends Millions On World Cup Grass
snippet.description:
Sponsored by Lenovo | FIFA

The 2026 FIFA World Cup is being played on some of the most heavily researched grass fields ever created. FIFA has spent millions of dollars working with turf scientists to engineer 16 stadium pitches across three countries and vastly different climates. We visited the University of Tennessee to see how robotic cleats, ball-launching machines, and stadium simulators helped prepare fields for the world's biggest sporting event. And we found out how World Cup grass is grown, tested, transported, and maintained before billions of viewers tune in.

snippet.title: Why Rolls-Royce Cars Are More Expensive Than Ever (with Supercar Blondie) | Well Spent
snippet.description:
Rolls-Royce cars have never been more expensive. While a new Rolls-Royce starts at around $370,000, many buyers spend hundreds of thousands, even millions, more on customizations. Some owners, like car influencer Supercar Blondie, pay aftermarket companies more to modify their cars than they paid for the vehicle itself.

Rolls-Royce customizes hand-painted coachlines and light-filled ceilings and makes one-off coachbuilt models costing tens of millions of dollars.
